sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Rohit Shrivastava, Panel Lawyer for State.
 Shri Narottam Sharma, Advocate for the respondent.
 Order

1. The applicant has preferred this application under Section 439(2) of Code of Criminal Procedure (in short "CrPC") for cancellation of bail granted to the respondent vide order dated 15.09.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.40251/2023 in relation to Crime No.92/2023 registered at Police Station Jaura, District Morena, M.P. for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(m), 342, 323,
506(2) of IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant/State submits that respondent/accused has been enlarged on bail vide earlier order dated 15.09.2023 passed in MCRC No.40251/2023 with certain terms and conditions including condition No.7 that "the applicant shall appear and mark his attendance before the SHO of the police station concerned once in 1st week of every month at 10 Am till conclusion of the trial, failing which, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to this Court".
But after releasing on bail, respondent has violated the aforesaid condition of bail bond and did not appear and mark his presence before the concerned police station.
Hence, he prays that his earlier bail order 15.09.2023 may be recalled and direction be issued that respondent should be taken into custody.
3. Leaned counsel for the respondent orally opposes the prayer and prays for its NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10163 2 MCRC-289-2024 rejection.

4. Heard both the parties and perused the record.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: From perusal of record, it appears that although, this Court has imposed aforesaid condition No.7 upon the respondent while granting bail and as per certification made by SHO, Jaura, it appears that respondent has not marked his presence before concerned police station.
Hence, it appears that respondent has violated the condition No.7 of bail order.

Hence, instant application filed by applicant under Section 439(2) of Cr.P.C. is allowed and bail granted to the respondent/accused vide order dated 15.09.2023 passed in MCRC No.40251/2023 related with the offence registered at crime No.92/2023 at Police Station Jaura, District Morena under Section 376, 376(2)(m), 342,
3213, 506(2) of IPC is hereby recalled.
6.
Accordingly, application is allowed and disposed of.
7. A copy of this order be sent to the concerned trial Court with a direction that respondent be taken into custody forthwith.

(ANIL VERMA) JUDGE R The State Of Madhya Pradesh vs Vikram Balmik on 7 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/49134388/
